```python
event_details = send_email(
    recipients=["your-email@example.com"],
    subject="Location of Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech",
    body="",
    cc=None,
    bcc=None,
    attachments=None
)

if events:
    for event in events:
        if event["title"] == "Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech":
            event_details["body"] = f"The location of the Dinner with Blue Sparrow Tech on May 24th is {event['location']}."
```
